proposedDecisions.sourcePath: Reuse /features/*/geometry for feature_position@1 and constrain this conversion to feature.sourceKey; keep sourcePath required and avoid expanding field-only paths used by exact-key linking.
proposedDecisions.option: Offer Position in the file only when no identifier field qualifies, keeping the question shortest without helper text; preserve identifierPaths and streamedIdentifierPaths as field-only filters.
proposedDecisions.position: Use sequencePosition.number for line-delimited originals, otherwise featureIndex + 1. Proved cuts must retain original positions, not renumber their accepted subset.

requiredOutsideOwn.why: Pass an explicit position-option prop to FieldChoice and remove the empty-field helper. Generic FieldChoice is also used by coordinate/WKT selects, so attaching position implicitly to all required selects or matching English label text is unsafe.
